Single-port limits, C3+A shared 5V rail, 110V/220V caps, and ADC 2.0 modes
Official AD1204U / AD1204 power architecture & ADC 2.0 rules
200–240V~ 50/60Hz: up to 120W total output (120W peak on C1 or C2 with 6A cable)
100–130V~ 50/60Hz: up to 110W total output (100W single-port cap on C1/C2)
PD 3.1/3.0 (up to 100W · 20V⎓5A), PPS, UFCS, QC & Xiaomi 120W HyperCharge (20V⎓6A on 220V). Independent high-power ADC 2.0 channels.
5V⎓3A, 9V⎓3A, 12V⎓2.5A, 15V⎓2A, 11V⎓4A (PD 3.0, PPS, UFCS, SCP). Ideal for smartphones and tablets when USB-A is idle.
5V⎓3A, 9V⎓2A, 12V⎓1.5A, 11V⎓3A (UFCS, SCP/FCP, QC, AFC). Supports 2h/4h Low-Current Mode for earbuds and watches.

Physically, USB-C3 and USB-A share one secondary buck rail. Used alone, each delivers full fast charge (44W / 33W). When BOTH C3 and USB-A are plugged in at the same time, fast charge steps down to a shared 5V / 15W rail — Cuktech merges them into a unified C3+A card to prevent double-counting.
• C1 + C2: dynamically splits up to 120W (e.g., 60W + 60W or priority laptop + phone)\n• C1/C2 + C3 (or USB-A): keeps primary C1/C2 fast-charging (up to 90W) + secondary 30W
• C1 + C2 + C3: balanced 3-port split (e.g., 45W + 45W + 30W)\n• All 4 ports (C1+C2+C3+A): up to 110–120W total with C3+A locked to 5V / 15W shared

• AI Mode: adaptive balancing across all active ports in real time.
• Hybrid: reserves high-wattage laptop budget on USB-C1 first.
• Single: dedicates full charger ceiling to a single high-draw port.
• Dual: reserves balanced dual-laptop power across C1 & C2 to reduce handshake resets.
